blocks.text: What ATP actually is, precisely: for any given period, it's the smaller of two numbers — Planned Available, and total demand — looked at across that period and every period after it. A shortage three months out can pull today's ATP down. It's also worth knowing that this planning-screen ATP figure is explicitly not guaranteed to match the number a real sales order gets checked against at entry — that's a different, separate calculation.
